Private Type DoubleBits
    v As Double
End Type
Private Type ByteBits
    b(7) As Byte
End Type

Private Function Bits(ByVal value As Variant) As String
    Dim d As DoubleBits, e As ByteBits, i As Long, s As String
    d.v = value
    LSet e = d
    For i = 7 To 0 Step -1
        s = s & Right$("0" & Hex$(e.b(i)), 2)
    Next
    Bits = s
End Function

Private Function Cells(ByVal r As Range) As String
    Dim c As Range, s As String
    For Each c In r
        If TypeName(c.Value) = "Double" Then
            s = s & "," & Bits(c.Value)
        Else
            s = s & "," & TypeName(c.Value) & ":" & CStr(c.Value)
        End If
        s = s & ":" & c.HasFormula & ":" & c.Text & ":" & c.Font.Bold & ":" & c.Interior.Color
    Next
    Cells = Mid(s, 2)
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim ws As Worksheet, s As String, i As Long
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Add
    For i = 0 To 52
        s = s & vbLf & Tried(ws, i)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    ws.Delete
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 2)
End Function

Private sink As SeriesSink

Public Function Events() As String
    Dim ws As Worksheet, s As String, wasOn As Boolean
    wasOn = Application.EnableEvents
    Application.EnableEvents = True
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Add
    ws.Range("A1").Value = 1
    ws.Range("C1").Value = 1
    ws.Range("E5").Select
    Set sink = New SeriesSink
    Set sink.App = Application
    ws.Range("A1:A5").DataSeries Rowcol:=xlColumns, Step:=1
    s = "column:" & sink.Log & "#selection " & Selection.Address(False, False)
    sink.Log = ""
    ws.Range("C1:C3,A7:A8").DataSeries Rowcol:=xlColumns, Step:=1
    s = s & "#areas:" & sink.Log
    sink.Log = ""
    ws.Range("G1:G3").DataSeries Rowcol:=xlColumns, Step:=1
    s = s & "#empty:" & sink.Log
    Set sink.App = Nothing
    Set sink = Nothing
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    ws.Delete
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Application.EnableEvents = wasOn
    Events = s
End Function
